name: Saved views + filter builder over one dataset
observed_behavior: Actions exist and are wired in source: addFilter/fEdit/fToggleVal/rmFilter/clearFilters, saveView/saveViewSubmit/renameView/delView, setViewMode, toggleCol, sorting and grouping actions; views persist in localStorage with the workspace state.
unverified_behavior: Server persistence, sharing views between users, permission-scoped views.
business_problem: Users re-create the same filtered lists daily.
jobs_to_be_done: Save a named filter+columns+sort configuration and reapply it in one click across board/list/table/calendar/timeline.
navigation_path: Any data view > Filters > Save view
actions: Add/edit/remove/clear filters, save/rename/delete view, switch view mode, toggle columns, sort, group
outputs: A persisted view definition applied to the dataset
data_entities: View {id, name, filters[], columns[], sort, group, viewMode}
proposed_api_contracts: PROPOSED: /v1/views CRUD with owner + shared scopes
automation_candidates: Saved views as automation triggers (view count crosses threshold)
edge_cases: Stale filters after schema change; view name collisions
security_privacy: Shared views must not leak filter values across permissions
responsive_accessibility: Filter chips keyboard-operable (partially verified in keyboard.js patterns)
benefit_hypothesis: Saved views cut repeated triage time and standardise team queues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a filtered table, when the user saves it as a view and switches to board, then the same filter set applies in board mode.
